description.en: Nothing but the form: no card, no background, a small left-aligned logo, quiet text tabs, hairline fields and a round button, with plenty of white space. CSS only, so organization admins can install it.
The button, checkboxes and the line under a focused field.

theme.json.formCss:
<style>
.login-background {
  color-scheme: light;
  --background: 0 0% 100%;
  --foreground: 0 0% 7%;
  --card: 0 0% 100%;
  --card-foreground: 0 0% 7%;
  --popover: 0 0% 100%;
  --popover-foreground: 0 0% 7%;
  --muted: 0 0% 97%;
  --muted-foreground: 0 0% 45%;
  --accent: 0 0% 96%;
  --accent-foreground: 0 0% 7%;
  --border: 0 0% 90%;
  --input: 0 0% 88%;
  --ring: 0 0% 7%;
  font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  background: #ffffff;
}
.login-content > div {
  max-width: 380px;
}
.login-panel {
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-logo-box {
  justify-content: flex-start;
  margin-bottom: 40px;
}
.login-logo-box img {
  max-height: 28px;
}
.signin-methods > div {
  height: auto;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
}
.signin-methods [role='tablist'] {
  justify-content: flex-start;
  gap: 20px;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'] {
  flex: none !important;
  padding: 0 0 6px;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent !important;
  color: #a3a3a3;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  color: #111111;
  box-shadow: inset 0 -1.5px 0 #111111 !important;
}
.login-form label {
  color: #737373;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 44px;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e5e5;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: #111111;
  font-size: 16px;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  border-bottom-color: {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 {{accentColor}};
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'] {
  border-color: #d4d4d4;
  border-radius: 3px;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  color: #ffffff;
}
.login-form a {
  color: #111111;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  height: 48px;
  margin-top: 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  opacity: 0.85;
}
.login-form .login-signup-link {
  justify-content: flex-start;
}
#footer {
  color: #a3a3a3;
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
